title: Northgate Tire Center Installation Appointments: Booking, Moving, Missed Appointments and Cancellation
content:
# Installation appointments

Scheduling guidance for Northgate Tire Center installation appointments.

## Booking

An installation appointment is booked for tires bought on a Northgate purchase.

## Moving an appointment

An appointment is moved only while its status is awaiting installation, and at most the number of times the package allows reschedules. The status is read from the package record, not from the member's account.

| Package status | Moves already made | Can the appointment be moved again? |
|---|---|---|
| awaiting installation | fewer than the reschedules the package allows | yes |
| awaiting installation | equal to the reschedules the package allows | no |
| installed, cancelled or retired | any | no |

## Missed appointment

When the member misses the appointment, the unmounted tires are held for the package's hold period in calendar days; if no new date is booked by then, the installation is cancelled.

## Cancellation

A cancelled installation leaves nothing charged on the package where the package so provides, and the unmounted tires can be returned under the purchase's own return rules.

## Mounted tires

Once mounted, tires are never returnable for a refund while the package does not allow mounted tires to be returned — problems with mounted tires are handled by the Northgate Tire Center's services, road hazard and treadwear rules.

## Hypothetical illustration

On a package allowing 2 reschedules, an appointment awaiting installation that has been moved once can be moved a second time; after that second move it cannot be moved again. Had the tires already been installed, the appointment could not be moved at all.
